title: Horses

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Horse
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Horses are large, strong animals. People have kept horses for at least 5,000 years. Some horses pull heavy things.
A male horse is called a stallion. A female horse is called a mare. A baby horse is called a foal. A small adult horse is called a pony. A group of horses is called a herd.
Fifty million years ago, there were no horses like the horses of today. The first horses were small animals.
